A1.01.coordinate: 大作文 > 第一段：图表数据定格描述 > 动态柱状图显著增长对比
A1.01.chinese: 正如柱状图清晰所示，发展中国家的手机用户数量从 2000 年的约 4 亿大幅激增至 2008 年的近 40 亿，而发达国家的这一数字则增长较为缓慢，稳定在约 10 亿。
A1.01.pitfall_alert: 【考研数据防坑】：注意中文“亿”的单位换算（1亿 = 100 million = 0.1 billion），切勿直译为 million 导致数据缩小100倍；同时注意 countries 复数与 those in 代词呼应；整段回译需确保时态统一为过去时（surged, stayed），载体定格词需加定冠词（in the chart）。
A1.01.scaffold:
句型建议：As is distinctly illustrated in the chart, [主体A] witnessed a dramatic surge in..., from... to..., while [主体B] experienced a rather slow increase and stayed at...
核心语素：surge dramatically from... to...（大幅激增）；experience a rather slow increase（增长缓慢）；stay at about...（稳定在）。
A1.01.master_version: As is distinctly illustrated in the chart, mobile-phone subscriptions in developing countries surged dramatically from about 0.4 billion in 2000 to nearly 4 billion in 2008, while those in developed countries experienced a rather slow increase and stayed at about 1 billion.
upgrade_notes: 主语名词化：采用 mobile-phone subscriptions 替代平面的 mobile phone users，语域专业度显著提升。
动词张力：以 surged dramatically 承载爆发式增量，极值还原精准到位。
代词平衡对称：后半句运用 those in developed countries 对称呼应复数 subscriptions，形成紧凑对照。
四要素一次还原：载体、双主体、周期与极值一气呵成。
A1.01.thinking_direction: 双主体走势动态对比；构建图表定格主谓骨架，准确呈现时空起止节点与增减走势对照。
A1.01.conservative_pitfall: 注意图表载体介词搭配、英文大数据数量级规范（千万/亿级表达），以及后半句主语代词呼应与时态一致性。（严禁直接剧透答案词）

A1.02.coordinate: 大作文 > 第一段：图表数据定格描述 > 饼图极值与并列等值定格
A1.02.chinese: 正如饼图清晰所示，新年礼物在春节消费中占据了最大份额，达到 40%，而交通与聚餐聚会则各占约 20%。
A1.02.pitfall_alert: 【考研数据防坑】：饼图必须写 in the pie chart；注意极值动词与介词搭配 account for the largest share of... at 40%；同时注意并列成分 each make up 中 each 作同位语时谓语动词用复数 make。
A1.02.scaffold:
句型建议：As is distinctly illustrated in the [Chart Type], [Item A] accounts for the largest share of [Metric], at [Percentage 1], while [Item B] and [Item C] each make up about [Percentage 2].
核心语素：pie chart; account for the largest share of...（占据最大份额）；make up about...（占比约）；festival spending。
A1.02.master_version: As is distinctly illustrated in the pie chart, New Year gifts account for the largest share of festival spending, at 40%, while transport and gatherings each make up about 20%.
upgrade_notes: 极值与并列双收束：一句之内同时定格第一大极值与两个并列次要项，信息密度极高。
介词定值：使用 at 40% 快速锚定数值，避免拖沓系动词。
同位语精准平衡：transport and gatherings each make up 句型干净利落。
A1.02.thinking_direction: 饼状图极值收束与并列次要项定格；一句话兼顾占比第一大项与后续并列项。
A1.02.conservative_pitfall: 注意饼图载体介词、占比动宾固定搭配，以及并列主语同位语结构下的主谓一致规范。（严禁直接剧透答案词）
A1.02.micro_cue: share / proportion (份额/占比); each make up (各自占比)

A1.03.coordinate: 大作文 > 第一段：图表数据定格描述 > 柱状图前缓后急多阶段走势
A1.03.chinese: 正如柱状图清晰所示，大学兼职学生比例在大一为 67.77%，大二和大三分别攀升至 71.13% 和 71.93%，随后在大四大幅飙升至 88.24%。
A1.03.pitfall_alert: 【考研语法防坑】：时间状语必须使用 among freshmen / in the sophomore and junior years / in the senior year，严禁写成 in freshmen 或 fourthed year；注意 holding a part-time job 作后置定语修饰 students，主语是 percentage，谓语用 climbed 单数。
A1.03.scaffold:
句型建议：As is distinctly illustrated in the chart, [Metric] climbed from [Data 1] among [Group 1] to [Data 2] and [Data 3] in [Stage 2], before surging to [Data 4] in [Stage 3].
核心语素：percentage of university students; climb from... to...（稳步爬升）；before surging to...（随后突变飙升）；holding a part-time job。
A1.03.master_version: As is distinctly illustrated in the chart, the percentage of university students holding a part-time job climbed from 67.77% among freshmen to 71.13% and 71.93% in the sophomore and junior years, before surging to 88.24% in the senior year.
upgrade_notes: 双节奏复合走势：以 climbed 立稳步主线，以 before surging to 点亮突变极值，层次分明。
多阶段压缩合并：巧妙压缩中间两组并列数据，句式毫不臃肿。
非谓语分词定性：holding a part-time job 作后置定语紧扣主体。
年级术语规范：freshmen / sophomore / junior / senior 四年级表达标准。
A1.03.thinking_direction: 双节奏复合走势（稳步爬升 + 突变飙升）；巧妙压缩合并中间并列数据，突出走势转折。
A1.03.conservative_pitfall: 注意年级表达规范、分词作后置定语修饰主体，以及主干谓语动词时态的一致性。（严禁直接剧透答案词）
A1.03.micro_cue: hold a part-time job (兼职); climb ... before surging (先爬升后飙升)

A1.04.coordinate: 大作文 > 第一段：图表定格 > 2011国内轿车市场份额消长真题首段
A1.04.chinese: 正如柱状图清晰所示，国内品牌轿车的市场份额从 2008 年的约 25% 飙升至 2009 年的 30% 以上，而日本和美国品牌的份额则略有下降，分别收缩至约 20% 和 15%。
A1.04.pitfall_alert: 【考研语法防坑】：注意分别分别收缩至用 respectively，且注意单位与介词搭配 contracted to about 20% and 15% respectively。
A1.04.scaffold:
句型建议：As is distinctly illustrated in the chart, the market share of [A] surged from... to..., whereas those of [B] and [C] declined slightly, contracting to... respectively.
核心语素：market share of domestic cars; surged to above 30%; contracted to... respectively.
A1.04.master_version: As is distinctly illustrated in the chart, the market share of domestic cars surged from about 25% in 2008 to above 30% in 2009, whereas those of Japanese and American brands declined slightly, contracting to about 20% and 15% respectively.
upgrade_notes: 分词伴随状语：contracting to... respectively 精炼交代多方并列结果。
对比连词切换：使用 whereas 替代平淡的 but，凸显学术语域。
A1.04.thinking_direction: 主体份额增减对照；前半句突出自主品牌突破，后半句对称收束合资品牌收缩。
A1.04.conservative_pitfall: 注意“分别”副词的修饰位置、数值范围介词选用，以及对照代词与复数名词的呼应。（严禁直接剧透答案词）
A1.04.micro_cue: domestic (自主/国内的); contract (收缩/缩减); respectively (分别)

A1.05.coordinate: 大作文 > 第一段：图表定格 > 2012员工工作满意度落差真题首段
A1.05.chinese: 正如表格清晰所示，某公司员工的工作满意度因年龄而差异显著：41岁至50岁的员工满意度最高，达到40%，而40岁以下的员工对工作不满意的比例则高达约60%。
A1.05.pitfall_alert: 【考研格式防坑】：表格题载体必须写 in the table（严禁写 in the chart）；注意 differ sharply in... by age 的动宾介词搭配。
A1.05.scaffold:
句型建议：As is distinctly illustrated in the table, [Entity] differ sharply in [Metric] by [Factor]. Those aged [X] are the most satisfied, at [P1], while [Group Y] express dissatisfaction, reaching [P2].
核心语素：differ sharply in job satisfaction; aged 41 to 50; dissatisfied with their jobs.
A1.05.master_version: As is distinctly illustrated in the table, a company's staff differ sharply in job satisfaction by age. Those aged 41 to 50 are the most satisfied, at 40%, whereas about 64% of employees under 40 feel dissatisfied with their work.
upgrade_notes: 总分结构破题：首句用 differ sharply by age 一语定性，次句迅速砸出极值落差。
载体严密匹配：精准选用 in the table 杜绝阅卷常识性扣分。
A1.05.thinking_direction: 表格多维度分类落差定格；先交代分类维度，再对比最高满意度与明显不满群体。
A1.05.conservative_pitfall: 注意表格题载体介词、形容词修饰年龄段的表达规范，以及百分比作主语时的谓语单复数。（严禁直接剧透答案词）
A1.05.micro_cue: differ in ... by age (因年龄而在...存在差异); dissatisfied (不满意的)

A1.06.coordinate: 大作文 > 第一段：图表定格 > 2014城乡人口结构变迁真题首段
A1.06.chinese: 正如柱状图清晰所示，城镇人口从 1990 年的 3 亿大幅激增至 2010 年的近 7 亿，而农村人口同期则稳步下降，稳定在约 6.7 亿。
A1.06.pitfall_alert: 【考研单位防坑】：注意 3 亿 = 300 million（或 0.3 billion）；7 亿 = 700 million；农村与城镇人口对比用 urban population 与 rural population。
A1.06.scaffold:
句型建议：As is distinctly illustrated in the chart, the urban population surged dramatically from... to..., while the rural population dropped steadily over the same period, resting at...
核心语素：urban population; surged dramatically; dropped steadily over the same period.
A1.06.master_version: As is distinctly illustrated in the chart, the urban population surged dramatically from 300 million in 1990 to 458 million in 2000, and further to nearly 670 million in 2010, while the rural population decreased steadily from about 800 million to roughly 670 million.
upgrade_notes: 三阶段递进句型：surged from... to... and further to... 还原长周期跨度数据。
对比呼应：while 从句使用 decreased steadily 平衡前半段激增走势。
A1.06.thinking_direction: 城乡人口此消彼长历史拐点定格；把握三十年间两条人口曲线的交汇变迁。
A1.06.conservative_pitfall: 注意千万与亿级大额人口数字的英文表达精度、双主体时态统摄，以及避免中式直译。（严禁直接剧透答案词）
A1.06.micro_cue: urban / rural population (城乡人口); decrease steadily (稳步下降)

A1.07.coordinate: 大作文 > 第一段：图表定格 > 2016高校学生旅游目的真题首段
A1.07.chinese: 正如柱状图清晰所示，欣赏风景在大学生旅游目的中高居榜首，占比达到 37%，缓解压力和结交朋友紧随其后，分别占 33% 和 16%。
A1.07.pitfall_alert: 【考研搭配防坑】：高居榜首用 accounts for the largest proportion / tops the list；紧随其后用 closely followed by... at... respectively。
A1.07.scaffold:
句型建议：As is distinctly illustrated in the chart, [Activity A] accounts for the largest proportion, at 37%, closely followed by [Activity B] and [Activity C], which make up 33% and 16% respectively.
核心语素：sightseeing; relieving stress; making friends; closely followed by.
A1.07.master_version: As is distinctly illustrated in the chart, sightseeing accounts for the largest proportion of students' travel purposes, at 37%, closely followed by relieving pressure and making friends, which make up 33% and 16% respectively.
upgrade_notes: 非谓语分词短语衔接：closely followed by 避免两个并列分句的单调拼接。
关系代词引导定格：which make up... respectively 结构严整。
A1.07.thinking_direction: 多要素排序占比定格；由第一名极值领衔，引出后续梯队并列百分比。
A1.07.conservative_pitfall: 注意动名词充当主语的句式平衡、非限制性定语从句补充数据的连接词选用与介词规范。（严禁直接剧透答案词）
A1.07.micro_cue: sightseeing (欣赏风景); relieve pressure (缓解压力); closely followed by (紧随其后)

A1.08.coordinate: 大作文 > 第一段：图表定格 > 2017博物馆数量与人数双增长真题首段
A1.08.chinese: 正如柱状图清晰所示，中国的博物馆数量从 2013 年的 4165 家稳步增至两年前的 4692 家，而参观人数则增长更为迅猛，从 6.37 亿人次激增至 7.81 亿人次。
A1.08.pitfall_alert: 【考研双主体防坑】：注意区分 museum 数量（number，可数）与 visitors 参观量（attendance / number of visitors）；单位亿用 million（637 million / 781 million）。
A1.08.scaffold:
句型建议：As is distinctly illustrated in the chart, the number of [Entity A] rose steadily from... to..., while [Metric B] surged even more rapidly, climbing from... to...
核心语素：rose steadily; surged even more rapidly; climbed from... to...
A1.08.master_version: As is distinctly illustrated in the chart, the number of museums in China rose steadily from 4,165 in 2013 to 4,692 two years later, while attendance grew even faster, climbing from 637 million to roughly 781 million.
upgrade_notes: 双主体走势分层：前半句稳步增长（rose steadily）与后半句加速狂飙（grew even faster, climbing from）形成鲜明节奏落差。
A1.08.thinking_direction: 双指标并进定格（场馆数量增长 vs 参观人次狂飙）；凸显后者的更快增速。
A1.08.conservative_pitfall: 注意区分“场馆数量（可数概念）”与“参观人次（考查客流词汇）”的选词差异与大数单位规范。（严禁直接剧透答案词）
A1.08.micro_cue: attendance (参观人次/出席人数); rise steadily vs grow even faster (稳增 vs 狂飙)

A2.01.coordinate: 大作文 > 第二段：因果机制推演 > 因果总起与定维骨架
A2.01.chinese: 这一急剧增长绝非偶然，而是植根于中国经济的稳健扩张以及居民消费观念的深刻转变两大核心维度。
A2.01.pitfall_alert: 【考研逻辑防坑】：避免空转套话“A number of factors contribute to...”；必须在首句直接给出归因维度（经济发展 + 观念转变）。
A2.01.scaffold:
句型建议：This [Trend Noun] is by no means accidental, but deeply rooted in two primary drivers: [Factor A] and [Factor B].
核心语素：by no means accidental（绝非偶然）；deeply rooted in（植根于）；primary drivers（主要驱动因素）。
A2.01.master_version: This sharp increase is by no means accidental, but deeply rooted in two primary drivers: the steady expansion of the Chinese economy and a profound shift in consumer mindset.
upgrade_notes: 替代平庸模板：用 is by no means accidental, but deeply rooted in 替代俗套的 There are many reasons。
名片式定维：冒号后直接列举两大支柱动因，阅卷老师一眼抓住逻辑骨架。
A2.01.thinking_direction: 归因总起句；聚焦“宏观经济 + 消费心理”双驱动维度，直击核心成因。
A2.01.conservative_pitfall: 避免空泛无意义套话，确保首句即明确给出两个具体归因维度，注意并列名词短语的对称结构。（严禁直接剧透答案词）
A2.01.micro_cue: by no means accidental (绝非偶然); deeply rooted in (植根于)

A2.02.coordinate: 大作文 > 第二段：场景语素组装 > 个人发展与成长场景
A2.02.chinese: 兼职工作使大学生能够将理论知识转化为实践技能，在积累宝贵社会经验的同时有效缓解家庭的经济负担。
A2.02.pitfall_alert: 【考研语法防坑】：enable sb. to do 搭配；注意 while doing 伴随状语保持主干清爽。
A2.02.scaffold:
句型建议：Part-time jobs enable students to translate theoretical knowledge into practical skills, effectively easing the financial burden on families while accumulating valuable social experience.
核心语素：translate theoretical knowledge into practical skills; ease the financial burden; accumulate valuable social experience.
A2.02.master_version: Taking part-time jobs enables college students to translate theoretical knowledge into practical skills, effectively easing their families' financial burden while accumulating invaluable social experience.
upgrade_notes: 动宾精准度：translate... into... / ease the financial burden 均为考研核心高分动宾语素。
分词伴随高效承重：easing... while accumulating... 双分词驱动结果。
A2.02.thinking_direction: 兼职与实践价值论述；从“理论转化实践”与“家庭减负”两个层面论证个人收益。
A2.02.conservative_pitfall: 注意动名词短语作主语时的谓语单数形式、使役动词后接宾语与不定式的规范，以及伴随状语的主动分词形式。（严禁直接剧透答案词）
A2.02.micro_cue: translate ... into ... (转化); ease financial burden (减轻财务负担)

A2.03.coordinate: 大作文 > 第二段：场景语素组装 > 消费经济与生活场景
A2.03.chinese: 工业化的大规模生产极大地降低了生产成本，使普通家庭能够承受优质商品，从而刺激了国内消费需求的持续繁荣。
A2.03.pitfall_alert: 【考研句式防坑】：避免写 Chinglish 句子 make goods cheap；使用 render + 宾语 + 形容词结构（render goods financially accessible）。
A2.03.scaffold:
句型建议：Industrial mass manufacturing has drastically brought down production costs, rendering [Goods] financially accessible to average households, thereby spurring [Outcome].
核心语素：industrial mass manufacturing; bring down production costs; financially accessible; spur domestic consumption.
A2.03.master_version: Industrial mass manufacturing has drastically brought down overhead costs, rendering quality products financially accessible to ordinary households and thereby spurring sustained domestic consumption.
upgrade_notes: 外刊级表达：render quality products financially accessible 远胜 make products cheap。
因果链闭环：drastically brought down costs -> financially accessible -> spurring consumption。
A2.03.thinking_direction: 经济机制因果链推演；“工业规模量产 -> 降本惠民 -> 刺激内需繁荣”三重推进。
A2.03.conservative_pitfall: 注意复合宾语（使...成为可能）的形容词用法，以及通过分词引导词（如 thereby + doing）实现严密因果衔接。（严禁直接剧透答案词）
A2.03.micro_cue: overhead costs (运营/生产成本); render ... accessible (使...变得触手可及); spur (刺激/加速)

A2.04.coordinate: 大作文 > 第二段：场景语素组装 > 文化传承与精神生活场景
A2.04.chinese: 随着物质生活水平的提高，人们不再仅仅满足于基本的衣食温饱，而是将更多的时间与金钱投入到精神追求和文化体验中。
A2.04.pitfall_alert: 【考研时态与结构防坑】：not merely... but rather... 对照结构；be satisfied with 基本生存需求。
A2.04.scaffold:
句型建议：With living standards climbing, citizens are no longer merely content with basic material needs, but rather channel substantial time and financial resources into cultural enrichment.
核心语素：content with basic material needs; channel... into...; cultural enrichment.
A2.04.master_version: With living standards steadily rising, people are no longer merely content with basic physical subsistence, but rather channel substantial time and financial resources into cultural enrichment and spiritual pursuits.
upgrade_notes: 观念转变今昔对比：no longer merely content with... but rather channel... 逻辑鲜明。
高阶语素：physical subsistence（物质温饱）/ cultural enrichment（文化滋养）。
A2.04.thinking_direction: 需求层级跃迁论述；由“基本温饱”跨越到“精神追求与文化体验”的对比升华。
A2.04.conservative_pitfall: 注意结构中的介词固定搭配与抽象名词不可数规范，保持前后语义转折的逻辑力度。（严禁直接剧透答案词）
A2.04.micro_cue: subsistence (温饱/生计); channel ... into ... (将...倾注于...); enrichment (充实/丰富)

A2.05.coordinate: 大作文 > 第二段：场景语素组装 > 科技互联网与创新场景
A2.05.chinese: 移动通信网络与智能手机的全面普及打破了信息壁垒，为边远地区的居民接入数字世界创造了空前便利的条件。
A2.05.pitfall_alert: 【考研搭配防坑】：打破信息壁垒用 dismantle/break down information barriers；接入数字世界用 grant access to the digital world。
A2.05.scaffold:
句型建议：The ubiquitous coverage of [Tech] has dismantled information barriers, granting residents in remote regions unprecedented access to the digital world.
核心语素：ubiquitous coverage; dismantle information barriers; grant unprecedented access to.

A4.01.coordinate: 大作文 > 真题全篇串联 > 2010手机用户走势全篇复盘

A4.01.pitfall_alert: 【全篇连贯防坑】：注意首段与次段之间、各动因之间的过渡词（First, Moreover, By contrast, Therefore），保证段落推进水到渠成。
A4.01.scaffold:
段落推进：
1. 首段：As is distinctly illustrated in the chart, mobile-phone subscriptions in developing countries surged... while those in developed countries...
2. 次段：A number of factors contribute to... First, with rapid economic development... Industrial mass manufacturing has drastically brought down overhead costs... Moreover, network coverage...
3. 尾段：This trend shows that... Therefore, both governments and companies should work together to...
A4.01.master_version:
As is distinctly illustrated in the chart, mobile-phone subscriptions in developing countries surged dramatically from about 0.4 billion in 2000 to nearly 4 billion in 2008, while those in developed countries experienced a rather slow increase and stayed at about 1 billion.

A number of factors contribute to this sharp increase. First, with rapid economic development, developing countries have built many modern industries and factories. Industrial mass manufacturing has drastically brought down overhead costs, rendering mobile phones financially accessible to the public. Second, these countries have a huge population, and mobile communication has become a basic need in daily life. Moreover, the rapid improvement of network coverage has made mobile services available even in remote areas. By contrast, the market in developed countries has been saturated for years, so the demand for new subscriptions is limited.

This trend shows that new technologies are spreading faster in developing countries, and it will bring more people into the digital world. Therefore, both governments and companies should work together to make mobile services cheaper and easier to use.

To consolidate this momentum, the government should continue to carry out sound policies, enterprises should keep sharpening their competitive edge, and consumers should be encouraged to choose green domestic products.

As is distinctly illustrated in the chart, sightseeing accounts for the largest proportion of students' travel purposes, at 37%, closely followed by relieving pressure and making friends, which make up 33% and 16% respectively.

Whatever their purposes, students benefit immensely from well-planned journeys. Schools and families should encourage students to travel responsibly, ensuring safety while embracing cultural and natural wonders.

A4.08.master_version:
As is distinctly illustrated in the chart, the number of museums in China rose steadily from 4,165 in 2013 to 4,692 two years later, while attendance grew even faster, climbing from 637 million to roughly 781 million.

This gap stems mainly from two factors. First, having secured material comforts, Chinese citizens are increasingly shifting their focus toward spiritual fulfillment and cultural enrichment. Second, government initiatives offering free admission to public museums, combined with innovative exhibitions and digital displays, have made cultural heritage far more accessible and engaging to ordinary people.

B3.03.coordinate: 小作文 > 各文类尾段收口 > 建议益处期许与助益收束
B3.03.chinese: 我衷心希望以上建议能对你即将开始的大学新征程有所助益。若你在行前还需要其他信息或帮助，随时写信告诉我。

句型建议：I sincerely hope that these suggestions will prove beneficial to your [Upcoming Event]. Should you need any further information, please feel free to drop me a line.
核心语素：prove beneficial to; drop me a line; wish you every success.
B3.03.master_version: I sincerely hope these suggestions will prove beneficial to your upcoming campus journey. Should you need any further assistance, please feel free to drop me a line. Wishing you every success in your university studies!
upgrade_notes: 地道动宾：prove beneficial to 比 be useful 高级得多。

B3.03.thinking_direction: 友人书信温情闭环；表达希望建议有所助益的美好祝愿，并主动提供后续行前沟通通道。
B3.03.conservative_pitfall: 注意希望从句中的谓语形式，形容词后置搭配介词的用法，以及非正式私人书信收尾的亲切自然度。（严禁直接剧透答案词）
B3.03.micro_cue: prove beneficial to (对...有所助益); drop me a line (随时写信告知)

B3.04.pitfall_alert: 【热切邀约句式】：look forward with great enthusiasm to...；确认参会用 confirm your availability by...

B3.04.thinking_direction: 热切期盼与确认时限；肯定对方出席的重要价值，礼貌请求在截止日前确认参会可能性。
B3.04.conservative_pitfall: 注意期盼短语中介词 to 之后接动名词的铁律，情态副词修饰动词的位置，以及确认日程的动宾搭配。（严禁直接剧透答案词）

B3.05.coordinate: 小作文 > 各文类尾段收口 > 歉意重申与改约协商
B3.05.chinese: 对于由此给您日程安排带来的不便，我再次致以最深切的歉意。不知下周待我身体康复之后，是否方便在您方便的时间重新安排拜访？
B3.05.pitfall_alert: 【改约高礼貌语气】：I wonder if it would be convenient for you to reschedule... 双层虚拟语气委婉探寻。

upgrade_notes: 双层软化语气：I wonder if it would be possible... 极致尊重长辈教授时间。
客套闭环：at your convenience 彰显教养与分寸感。
B3.05.thinking_direction: 歉意重申与改约协商；再次致歉日程冲突，以双层委婉语气商讨待康复后重新安排拜访的可行性。
B3.05.conservative_pitfall: 注意重申歉意时名词与介词搭配，委婉探寻句型中的虚拟语气用法，以及“以对方方便为准”的固定表达。（严禁直接剧透答案词）
B3.05.micro_cue: apologies for (为...致歉); reschedule (重新安排); at your convenience (在您方便时)

B4.01.coordinate: 小作文 > 真题分类串联 > 建议与推荐信组串联复盘
B4.01.chinese: 请按文体串联复盘建议信核心套路：以 2011 年大学迎新准备信为例，写出完整的信件主体：开篇祝贺与理解心境、正文财务预算与课外活动双建议（先动作后理由）、尾段温暖寄语（约 105 词）。
B4.01.pitfall_alert: 【建议信全篇格式】：称谓 Dear Li Ming，署名 Yours sincerely, Zhang Wei；正文分两条 bullet 或两个层次展开。
B4.01.scaffold: 结构骨架：Congratulations on... Knowing that... I am writing to share... To begin with, you had better... for doing so can... Furthermore, I advise you to... I sincerely hope these suggestions will prove beneficial...
B4.01.master_version:
Dear Li Ming,

    Congratulations on your admission to such a prestigious university! Knowing that you are both thrilled and somewhat apprehensive about campus life, I am writing to offer several practical suggestions for your preparation.

    To begin with, you had better learn to manage your monthly budget and allocate expenses reasonably, for doing so can prevent you from falling into financial distress toward the end of each semester. Furthermore, I advise you to balance academic routines with extracurricular activities, which will enrich your campus experience and expand your interpersonal network.

    I sincerely hope these suggestions will prove beneficial to your upcoming journey. Wishing you every success!

Yours sincerely,
Zhang Wei
upgrade_notes: 私人书信金牌模板：祝贺与共情开篇 -> 财务与活动双轨建议 -> 温暖祝福收口。
动词句式层次：you had better learn to... / I advise you to balance... with...
B4.01.thinking_direction: 建议信全篇格式与内容串联；开篇祝贺与理解心境、正文财务预算与课外活动双建议、尾段温暖寄语收口。
B4.01.conservative_pitfall: 注意书信格式（称谓、署名）、正文建议的逻辑推进，以及私人朋友书信得体亲切的语体契约。（严禁直接剧透答案词）
B4.01.micro_cue: practical recommendations (实用建议); balance academics and activities (平衡学业与活动)

B4.02.coordinate: 小作文 > 真题分类串联 > 通知与倡议书组串联复盘
B4.02.chinese: 请以 2015 年夏令营志愿者招募通知为例，完整复盘通知公告文书结构：标题 Notice 置顶并标注日期、首段活动背景与招募指标、正文岗位职责与资质门槛、尾段报名方式与截止日期（约 100 词）。
B4.02.pitfall_alert: 【通知公文格式】：顶格居中写 Notice；日期写在下一行右侧或居右；正文无称谓；末尾落款机构名（如 Postgraduates' Association）。
B4.02.scaffold: 结构骨架：Notice / Date / To help high school students gain exposure to... our university is scheduled to recruit... Applicants are expected to... Furthermore, preference will be given to... Should you have any inquiries... The deadline is...
B4.02.master_version:
Notice

May 10th, 2026

To help high school students gain exposure to university life, our university is scheduled to host an international summer camp this July, and 20 volunteers are urgently needed.

Applicants are expected to possess fluent spoken English, strong organizational skills, and a high sense of responsibility. Furthermore, preference will be given to candidates with prior volunteer experience in cross-cultural activities.

Should you have any inquiries, please contact us at volunteer@campus.edu. The deadline for registration is May 25th.

Postgraduates' Association
upgrade_notes: 公文规范排版：Notice 标题居中，机构署名纯正。
倒装与被动：preference will be given to / Should you have any inquiries 语言极其严谨。
B4.02.thinking_direction: 招募通知公告全篇串联；Notice 居中标题与日期置顶、首段活动背景与名额、正文任职门槛、尾段报名截止通道。
B4.02.conservative_pitfall: 严格遵守通知公文排版规范（标题居中、无称谓、落款机构名与日期），确保正文客观严谨。（严禁直接剧透答案词）
B4.02.micro_cue: Notice header (Notice 标题规范); qualification requirements (任职资格); deadline (截止日期)

B4.03.coordinate: 小作文 > 真题分类串联 > 回复与致谢组串联复盘
B4.03.chinese: 以 2017 年接受邀请并汇报展示要点为例，复盘回复信结构：称谓致敬、首段感谢邀请并欣然接受、正文汇报展示内容（春节文化内涵与传统习俗）、尾段征求反馈与礼貌收口（约 108 词）。
B4.03.pitfall_alert: 【学术回信语域】：致信教授称谓 Dear Professor Williams；汇报要点用 My presentation will revolve around...
B4.03.scaffold:
结构骨架：Dear Professor Williams,
Thank you for your gracious invitation. I am honored to accept it... My presentation will revolve around... Specifically, I will explore... and highlight... Please let me know if any adjustment is needed. Looking forward to...
B4.03.master_version:
Dear Professor Williams,

    Thank you very much for your gracious invitation. I am honored and pleased to accept it. It provides an exceptional opportunity to share Chinese traditional culture with your students.

    My presentation will revolve around the Spring Festival, one of the most treasured cultural events in China. Specifically, I plan to elaborate on its historical origins, core family values, and unique festive customs, such as family reunion dinners and temple fairs. Visual aids and folk handicrafts will also be displayed to make the presentation lively.

    Please let me know if any adjustment is needed. I look forward to meeting you all.

Yours sincerely,
Zhang Wei
upgrade_notes: 详略得当的方案汇报：历史渊源 + 核心价值观 + 民俗细节 + 道具辅助。
主动征求导师意见：Please let me know if any adjustment is needed 尽显治学严谨。
B4.03.thinking_direction: 学术回复信全篇串联；致信教授敬语、首段致谢并欣然受邀、正文展示提纲汇报、尾段征求反馈与礼貌收口。
B4.03.conservative_pitfall: 严格保持学术师生沟通的高礼貌尊称与正式书信格式，正文使用分词与宾语从句清晰呈现展示要点。（严禁直接剧透答案词）
B4.03.micro_cue: academic register (学术正式语域); presentation outline (展示提纲); feedback (征求反馈)

B4.04.coordinate: 小作文 > 真题分类串联 > 投诉与道歉组串联复盘
B4.04.chinese: 以 2012 年投诉信为例，完整复盘交涉文书：称谓 Dear Sir or Madam、首段交易定点并正式投诉、次段前置信任反差与屏幕电池双缺陷控诉、末段限期全额退款或换机诉求（约 112 词）。
B4.04.pitfall_alert: 【投诉信商务规范】：避免人身攻击；事实说话；诉求清晰可衡量。
B4.04.scaffold:
结构骨架：Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to lodge a formal complaint regarding... Having placed high trust in your brand, I was dismayed to discover that... Under these circumstances, I believe it is entirely reasonable for me to demand a full refund or an immediate replacement within three working days. Looking forward to...
B4.04.master_version:
Dear Sir or Madam,

    I am writing to lodge a formal complaint regarding the electronic dictionary that I purchased from your online store the other day, and to urge your department to offer a prompt, satisfactory solution.

    Having placed high trust in your brand, I was dismayed to discover that the device suffers from a severe screen display defect, and that the battery fails to charge properly. Despite contacting your online customer service repeatedly, I have not received any constructive response.

    Under these circumstances, I believe it is entirely reasonable for me to demand a full refund or an immediate replacement within three working days. I look forward to your prompt reply.

Yours faithfully,
Zhang Wei
upgrade_notes: 公文三段式递进：交易事实与投诉 -> 质量瑕疵与售后无门 -> 限期退款与换机诉求。
署名规范：Dear Sir or Madam 对应 Yours faithfully。
B4.04.thinking_direction: 商务投诉信全篇串联；称谓致敬、首段正式立案投诉、正文前置信赖与双缺陷控诉、尾段限期退款或换机诉求。
B4.04.conservative_pitfall: 注意商务交涉的专业态度，事实清楚、诉求明确，避免情绪化词汇，确保落款合规。（严禁直接剧透答案词）
B4.04.micro_cue: formal complaint (正式投诉); defective product (缺陷产品); full refund or replacement (退款或换机)

B4.05.coordinate: 小作文 > 真题分类串联 > 邀请与协商组串联复盘
B4.05.chinese: 以 2021 年邀请参加行程规划线上会议为例，完整复盘邀请信结构：首段以对方兴趣破题并正式邀约、正文交代会议时间地点议题（讨论路线/安全预算）、尾段期盼回复与截止确认（约 106 词）。

Knowing that you are eager to... I am writing to cordially invite you to... The meeting is scheduled for... During the session, we will finalize our travel itinerary, discuss safety precautions, and determine accommodation bookings. We are looking forward to your participation... Please confirm your availability by...
B4.05.master_version:
Dear Jack,

    Knowing that you are eager to learn about Chinese history, I am writing to cordially invite you to attend an online planning meeting for our upcoming historical journey.

    The meeting is scheduled for 8:00 p.m. this Saturday via Tencent Meeting. During the session, we will finalize our travel itinerary, compare several must-visit cultural heritage sites, and discuss practical matters such as transportation and budget allocation. Your suggestions will be extremely valuable to our team.

    We all look forward with great enthusiasm to your participation. Please confirm your availability by this Thursday.

Yours sincerely,
Zhang Wei

礼貌推动行动：Please confirm your availability by this Thursday 杜绝拖延。
